channel.title: KALAM ARTS STUDIO Journal
channel.description: Practical guides to art, craft and model projects from KALAM ARTS STUDIO, Abu Dhabi.

item.title: What to prepare before commissioning a 3D model
item.description: A practical checklist for a 3D model brief: purpose, sketches, AutoCAD drawings, dimensions, scale, materials, display needs and deadline. From KALAM ARTS STUDIO, Abu Dhabi.

item.title: How to choose custom canvas art for your space
item.description: How to plan custom canvas art for a home or office: wall measurements, room palette, mood, composition, subject, finish and the details to send an Abu Dhabi art studio.

item.title: How to choose a reference photo for a custom portrait
item.description: Learn how to choose and send a clear reference photo for a custom pencil portrait: focus, lighting, crop, number of people and gift details.

item.title: Planning a school science project model in Abu Dhabi
item.description: Plan a school science model with a clear brief, accurate labels, dimensions, materials and deadline. A practical guide from KALAM ARTS STUDIO, Abu Dhabi.

item.title: How to plan a custom mural or wall-art project in the UAE
item.description: A practical guide to planning a mural in the UAE: measure the wall, assess the surface, set the design direction and confirm permissions and site access.

item.title: Commissioning a custom portrait drawing as a personal gift
item.description: Plan a custom portrait drawing as a gift. Learn how to choose a reference photo, composition, size and timing before requesting a quote in Abu Dhabi.
